headline: Chase Freedom Flex Q3 2026 Bonus Categories Announced: Maximize Points on Gas, Transit, and More
reasoning: This topic is highly relevant to travel, specifically points and miles strategy, offering clear actionable advice for readers to earn more rewards. The information is timely for Q3 2026 and comes from a reputable source in the points and miles community, making it valuable for readers looking to optimize their credit card spending for travel benefits.
summary: Chase has announced the Q3 2026 bonus categories for the Freedom Flex card, offering 5x points on gas stations, public transit, EV charging, select live entertainment, and United Way donations. Cardholders must register between June 15 and September 14, 2026, to earn bonus points from July 1 to September 30, 2026.

source_articles.title: Chase Freedom Flex Categories: How To Earn 5x Points For Q3 2026
